title: Kafa Tamo
brief: A website for Kafa Tamo, a small specialty coffee roastery in Sarajevo. They sell single-origin beans online with a monthly subscription (three tiers: Taster, Regular, Office), run a tiny café with opening hours, publish a brewing guide for džezva, V60 and espresso, and take wholesale inquiries from cafés and hotels through a form. Prices, the current origins, the café address and the opening hours are not final yet, so show them as clearly marked placeholders rather than inventing them. Online checkout is not connected yet: say so honestly instead of showing a fake order confirmation, and the wholesale form must not pretend an inquiry was sent.

source.adaptation: Verbatim, plus two honesty sentences: the owner supplied no prices, origins, address or hours (placeholders), and checkout and the wholesale form are not connected.
